blocks.text: Two years after its founding in October 2024, The CONSILIERÉ Group (CSL) enters its third year with a portfolio spanning public institutions, Filipino enterprises, industry organizations, media production, and international projects. For the Makati-based strategic communications firm, that growth reflects a central ambition: to help the people and organizations it serves communicate with clarity, credibility, and purpose. Much of CSL’s early work centered on making public-interest information more accessible. In 2025, the firm handled the conceptualization, production, and digital rollout of the Department of Trade and Industry’s (DTI) Asenso Pilipino program, bringing stories of Filipino entrepreneurs and micro, small, and medium […]...
